title: Stir-Fried Nostalgic Noodles
description: A fusion of traditional Chinese flavors with a hint of nostalgia. This dish combines savory stir-fried noodles with the aromatic taste of garlic.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the stir-fry sauce and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the noodles to the skillet and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until they are well coated with the sauce.
Transfer the noodles to a serving platter and sprinkle with sesame seeds and chopped scallions.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
